schema_version: 2
scene:
  id: 01M20Y1NPQFFHDQRENTY3XDRB6
  editorial_head: 01M20Y7EF22GR710FJAJWAP38J
  name: Ashfall council hearing
  summary: 'Native keyboard draft: the council waits for the logbook.'
  beats:
  - id: 01M20Y1NQ7K181572PPQQCTHKS
    title: Present evidence
    intents:
    - subject: player
      intent: Secure an investigation while preserving the council’s trust.
    dialogue:
    - id: 01M20Y1NQ79KYS7PXCKRZKAY79
      speaker: player
      policy: edited
      variants:
      - id: 01M20Y1NQ7P0G78BDXSJEWBK01
        text:
          revision: af810e1c3ec78d1578022fd38a523c04
          body: I brought the logbook. Let the council judge the evidence.
          provenance: human
          lifecycle:
            policy: edited
            review: draft
            freshness: current
    choices:
    - id: 01M20Y1NQ7WSE1AR67YCEK7Q27
      label: Present the logbook
      requires:
        all:
        - compare:
            var: ashfall_knows_logbook
            op: eq
            value:
              literal: true
        - compare:
            var: ashfall_trust
            op: ge
            value:
              literal: 40
      effects:
      - add:
          var: ashfall_trust
          by: 10
      - command:
          name: ashfall_file_record
      to:
        beat: 01M20Y1NQ7B7AGJM3YS3SW6DY0
    - id: 01M20Y1NQ7TQQXTWS2DDD1W51E
      label: Ask for a fair hearing
      effects:
      - add:
          var: ashfall_trust
          by: 5
      to:
        beat: 01M20Y1NQ7B7AGJM3YS3SW6DY0
    - id: 01M20Y1NQ7P71YQ9DAE5GA79RV
      label: Challenge the council’s silence
      effects:
      - add:
          var: ashfall_trust
          by: -10
      to:
        beat: 01M20Y1NQ7B7AGJM3YS3SW6DY0
  - id: 01M20Y1NQ7B7AGJM3YS3SW6DY0
    title: Council response
    dialogue:
    - id: 01M20Y1NQ7STS40VP6H0JC14E1
      speaker: narrator
      policy: edited
      variants:
      - id: 01M20Y1NQ795Q4KP0BZWVMWN91
        when:
          compare:
            var: ashfall_record_filed
            op: eq
            value:
              literal: true
        text:
          revision: 857eeeb6008122ae900ca44017edefe8
          body: The council accepts the record. An investigation will begin.
          provenance: human
          lifecycle:
            policy: edited
            review: draft
            freshness: current
      - id: 01M20Y1NQ7J14FF8EV4TWSGYMP
        when:
          compare:
            var: ashfall_knows_logbook
            op: eq
            value:
              literal: true
        text:
          revision: 0fba25c0880edd78a7d766ae5467b80f
          body: The clerk asks to see the logbook before the council will act.
          provenance: human
          lifecycle:
            policy: edited
            review: draft
            freshness: current
      - id: 01M20Y1NQ7MPTE5V641ZCA77TH
        text:
          revision: d957f20e1aa8e0cc3ec715843da5b23e
          body: The council asks Kael to find a witness who can establish what happened.
          provenance: human
          lifecycle:
            policy: edited
            review: draft
            freshness: current
    outcomes:
    - id: 01M20Y1NQ796Y5JDTBVBH5YBK7
      to:
        end:
          label: Hearing complete
